scope: Complete warm eager 3D attention forward; synthetic normalized LTX-layout operands. No complete decoder or backward timing.

source.post_timing_change: Compact dispatch narrowed from vector>=2 to the measured vector==8; timed eight-element layouts unchanged. Final CPU and aligned/unaligned GPU dispatch checks passed.

measurement.timing: Complete warm eager attention calls, including mask construction, stacking, copies, output layout and Python work. Synchronized wall time is primary; CUDA-event spans include host launch gaps. No graph capture or complete decoder timing.
measurement.input_contract: B1, D64, contiguous LTX BTHWHD layout, normalized synthetic Q/K, Q pre-scaled by 0.125, scale=1.0, no autograd.
measurement.order: Alternating order per repeat; previous control included in the same process.

float16.scope: Sum of stage medians weighted by decoder block counts (4,6,4,2,8), one diffusion step, 17-frame 512x512 configuration. Not a measured decoder latency.

bfloat16.scope: Sum of stage medians weighted by decoder block counts (4,6,4,2,8), one diffusion step, 17-frame 512x512 configuration. Not a measured decoder latency.

full_coordinate_accuracy.scope: Independent full-coordinate native CPU FP64 on held-out normalized LTX-layout synthetic inputs. Actual-output corrected policy separately checked for our gradients.

validation.ordinary_initial_attempt: Environment error before kernel execution: Ninja was installed but its launcher was absent from PATH. Retry exposed the existing runtime bin directory and passed all three tests.

qualification_notes: Measured valid eight-element vector copies; final compact dispatch is restricted to that layout. Two-term forward applies to all 3D fallbacks too.
Native CPU FP64, not emulation. Random sample seed 1729 is disjoint from tuning seed 521; full-coordinate evaluation seed 99173 is separate.
dQ/dK corrections and input-rounded P for dV remain the existing neighborhood contract. Gradient improvements are not universal per coordinate or head.
Raw traces, binaries, failed operands and frozen experiment snapshots are retained outside the tracked tree.
Nsight Compute reported ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM. No measured stall, cache-hit or occupancy claims. Code captures are separate untimed same-configuration replays.

code_inspection.scope: Separate untimed same-configuration replay, not binary extraction from timed process.
code_inspection.ltx_runtime_generated_sass: Exact profiled symbol not found in packaged cuDNN shared libraries; no substitute symbol used.

telemetry_summary.scope: Whole campaign samples at GPU utilization >=90%; not per-call clocks or a cycle normalization.
